intro: We do not publish package prices, because a kitchen is not a package. What your project costs depends on the cabinet line, the door style, the countertop material, and how much of the room is moving. What we will do is tell you the numbers that most remodelers keep to themselves: HomeCrest cabinetry runs about a three-week lead time and Omega semi-custom five to six, a full kitchen averages six to eight weeks from order to completion, countertops arrive one to two weeks after templating, and orders take a 75% deposit with the balance due on completion. Design consultation is free — come in, look at real doors and real slabs, and we will price the room you actually have.
